hypothesis: RUNTIME surface, one retrieval upgrade: an INDEX-BACKED bm25 lane under the term search tools, with the v4 scan lane kept as the always-available fallback. Today search_evidence matches pack/card TITLES only (card bodies and unit text/quotes are structurally invisible to it) and search_claims has NO ranking at all (whole-query substring filter in ledger order). The stage-3c FTS surfaces (cards/units/claims, fts-v1 analyzer with CJK unigram+bigram postings) already exist in the machine-local shadow database, verified by build-time parity. v5: when the shadow is available and its analyzer stamp matches, search_evidence retrieves over cards_fts + units_fts (bm25 top-k, hits aggregated to packs) and RRF-fuses (k=60, same constant as retrieve.rs) with the existing title lane; search_claims ranks by claims_fts bm25 with the substring filter as fallback. When the shadow is missing, stale-stamped, or OVP_ASK_FTS=0, both tools take the exact v4 path. Every result names its lane (fts|scan) so transcripts stay diagnosable. Predicted: body-text recall becomes possible for evidence search; claim search gains relevance ordering; v4 behavior is byte-identical whenever the fts lane is off.

predicted_delta.coverage: fixture replay (falsifiable now): queries matching ONLY card body or unit quote text — 0 hits under v4's title-only search_evidence — return the correct pack under v5 with the shadow present; with the shadow absent, v4 fixtures pass unmodified (fallback is the v4 code path). predicted_delta.operational_reliability: zero new failure modes on missing/stale shadow (lane falls back, result says so); search_claims results ordered by bm25 relevance instead of ledger order — fewer rounds burned paging past irrelevant claims; OVP_ASK_FTS=0 restores v4 behavior without a rebuild.

guardrails.fallback_is_v4: with no shadow db, an analyzer-stamp mismatch, or OVP_ASK_FTS=0, both tools execute the unmodified v4 scan path — all prior v2/v3/v4 fixtures pass against the fallback lane
guardrails.lane_honesty: every search_evidence/search_claims result carries lane: fts|scan; a silent lane flip cannot masquerade as a recall change in transcripts
guardrails.coverage_semantics_unchanged: truncated, query_terms_truncated, matched_terms, and the executor's coverage accounting keep their v4 meanings in both lanes
guardrails.result_shape_compatible: hit fields are a superset of v4's (additive lane/rank fields only) — the agent prompt contract and portal consumers parse unchanged
guardrails.read_only: the fts lane opens the shadow read-only; ask can never write or rebuild the projection

eval_plan.replay_set: unit fixtures: body-only query (matches card content, not any title) → correct pack via fts lane, 0 hits via scan lane; unsegmented CJK body query recalls; claims query ranked by bm25 with the expected claim first; shadow-absent runs produce v4-identical results with lane: scan; analyzer-mismatch shadow falls back rather than erroring the tool; OVP_ASK_FTS=0 forces scan lane. All prior v2/v3/v4 fixtures pass unmodified. Live qrels remain the phase-3 quality gate.

rollback: Set OVP_ASK_FTS=0 (instant, no rebuild) or revert the lane dispatch — the scan path is the v4 code untouched; no persisted state, no prompt-namespace dependency.
